language_scope: Multilingual patient queries and multilingual knowledge retrieval
instruction: Use the same embedding model and preprocessing policy for indexed documents and queries. Do not mix embedding models within one Qdrant collection.
notes: BGE-M3 is used for multilingual semantic retrieval; it is not the clinical decision-maker.
Retrieval returns candidates. Patient confirmation, KB validation, scoring, safety, and therapist review remain separate stages.
Do not store governance_rules.json as ordinary retrievable knowledge; keep it as control logic.
